markdown: **Activate—Lash Out!** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The effigy causes spectral tentacles to erupt from the ship's hull. These tentacles lash out in an emanation with a distance equal to the ship's length and remain active for 10 minutes. Creatures in the aura and in the same body of water as the ship take a –2 circumstance penalty to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39) as the writhing tentacles lash out in all directions.
